---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement to the infrastructure or documentation
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: Harshads-git
---

## Summary
What would you like to see added or improved?

## Motivation
Why would this improvement be valuable? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Approach
How would you implement this? Include specific technologies, resources, or patterns.

## Alternatives Considered
What other approaches did you consider and why did you reject them?

## Additional Context
- Which part of the project does this affect? (K8s, Terraform, CI/CD, Docs)
- Is this a day N+ addition? Where would it fit in the 20-day roadmap?
